critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is now ~3650 lines — strongly recommend extracting at least the new AI pre-screen block (lines 1144-1367, ~220 lines) into /app/backend/ai_kyc_prescreen.py with its helpers (_DOC_MIME_BY_EXT, _mime_from, _download_admin_doc, _parse_ai_json, _ai_screen_doc) and importing the router. Eases future LLM-model swaps and unit testing.

_ai_screen_doc iterates docs sequentially (server.py:1325-1337) — for contacts with 5+ docs the wall-clock time grows linearly (3-8s/doc). Consider asyncio.gather() with bounded concurrency (e.g. 4 parallel) to cut latency. Today's contact has 1 doc so impact is invisible.

_download_admin_doc writes to a NamedTemporaryFile in /tmp with no size cap — a malicious/oversized upstream URL could fill the container disk. Add a httpx response.aread() max-bytes check, or stream with a limit, before persisting.

ai_prescreen_kyc returns 503 if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing (good) but does NOT return a structured error for the partial-failure case (e.g. one doc returns {'model': 'error'}). The summary counts that doc as 'unclear' silently. Consider exposing a 'failures' count in ai_prescreen_summary so the UI can warn the rep that not every doc was scanned.

Outbound queue write at server.py:1354 fires AFTER docs are scanned but BEFORE the response — if upstream is slow this can stretch the request. Today it's an async db insert into admin_bridge_outbound (the actual HTTP delivery happens in a background sweeper) so latency impact is negligible — verified by reading queue_outbound.

Frontend KycMirrorCard.jsx:62 calls api.post then await load(false) — during the reload the docs section briefly shows 'Loading KYC from Trata Admin App…' and the summary banner disappears. Consider keeping state.contact.ai_prescreen_summary visible during reload (optimistic update from the POST response) instead of going to skeleton.

OUTBOUND_NAME_MAP maps crm.kyc.ai_prescreened → kyc.note_added. Conceptually 'ai_prescreened' is a richer event than 'note_added' — the upstream admin app loses the structured summary. Consider adding a dedicated kyc.ai_prescreened event on the admin side instead of bucketing into note_added.

Use-suggestion link (KycMirrorCard.jsx:269) is gated on `!myReview && aiRec.recommendation !== 'unclear'`. If the rep already has a myReview from a previous flow, the link disappears entirely — so for the canonical 'AI recommended approve, rep already rejected' confusion case there's no UI affordance to flip back. Acceptable but worth product validation.
